recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style album cover featuring a group of people standing in a sun-drenched, tall-grass field, framed by a ragged, torn-paper border against a cream background, with a prominent white promotional information block at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The central group is silhouetted against a bright, hazy sun flare.
The torn-edge photo frame creates a tactile, scrapbook-like contrast with the clean outer border.
The heavy informational block at the bottom anchors the ethereal, soft-focus imagery above.
Warm golden-brown tones in the field harmonize with the cream-colored paper stock.
coreInvariants: High-key sun flare washing out the center-top of the image
Two-column informational grid at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six figures positioned in the middle ground, varying in scale to create depth within a golden field.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white rectangular 'Radio Station Service' block at the bottom of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, move down through the sun flare to the group, and settle on the dense text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored margins surrounding the central torn-edge photograph.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white for the background and margins.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks within the photograph and for the primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and sepia tones from the sun-lit field.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the sky/flare, transitioning to high contrast in the foreground shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and aged paper hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serifs and condensed sans-serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses swash-like terminals and tight kerning.
Metadata text uses rigid, geometric, all-caps sans-serif forms.
Body text is organized in a strict two-column grid with dot leaders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curled descenders on lowercase 'y' and 'g' in the display serif.
Elongated crossbars on uppercase 'A' in the sans-serif block.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the artistic title paired with a functional, industrial sans-serif for technical data.

avoid: Clean vector edges for the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s display serif feel with decorative terminals.
Matches the utilitarian, bold look of the bottom information block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of a group of people in a golden wheat field at sunset with heavy lens flare, processed with a 1970s film grain and sepia tint. The photo should have irregular, torn paper edges and be centered on a cream-colored textured paper background. Leave a large white rectangular space at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a decorative serif title at the top center. In the bottom white rectangle, typeset a two-column list of text using a bold condensed sans-serif, including checkboxes and dot leaders to align numbers to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the photo edge visibly 'torn' rather than straight?
Is the sun flare centered and hazy?
Does the bottom text block look like a technical radio service sticker?
Is the color palette restricted to cream, brown, and gold?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the field
Density of the bottom text columns
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torn edge looks organic and not repetitive.
Check that the sun flare doesn't obscure the group entirely.
Verify the bottom text is legible and follows the two-column grid.
Confirm the overall tone is warm and nostalgic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Torn Edge Photo of Group in Field] + [Sun Flare Effect] + [Cream Paper Background] + [Top Serif Title] + [Bottom Technical Sans-Serif Block].
